'''Imfaral''' is the sixth-largest city in the Empire of [[Seanchan]] and is famed as the location of the [[The Towers of Midnight]], a large fortress complex.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Imfaral}} Imfaral is a port city located on the easternmost peninsula of the northern landmass of the Seanchan continent, on the dividing channel between the two landmasses.

Imfaral was captured during the early days of [[the Conquest]] and used as a base of operations by [[Luthair Paendrag Mondwin]]'s forces until they secured [[Seandar]] later in the war.
